title: Coupled double Poisson brackets
summary: We introduce coupled double Poisson brackets on an associative algebra $A$ as pairs consisting of a generalized Van den Bergh's double Poisson bracket and a generalized Fairon--McCulloch's right double Poisson bracket subject to a cross-Jacobi identity.
